text:
kai-partners: Heads up, new partner (Nimbus Devices) wants to list an edge gateway. Marketplace requires signed firmware, SBOM, SOC2 pointer, pen-test (redacted), and chain-of-custody. Can we agree on a minimal artifact package + upload flow?

mira-security: Minimum: SOC2 summary URL, redacted pentest PDF (PII & customer names removed), CycloneDX SBOM, detached signatures for firmware with an RFC3161 timestamp token, and chain-of-custody PDF signed by vendor. Include signer metadata (KMS/HSM id).

leo-eng: Packaging: one gz archive per release named nimbus/<version>/attest.tar.gz plus "manifest.json" at root listing filenames and sha256 sums. README.md with redaction notes and contact.

oliver-hw: Nimbus here we can produce detached .sig files and request RFC3161 timestamps from TimeStampR. We also have HSM attestation logs. How should we deliver?

sara-ps: Upload flow proposal: partner requests presigned multipart upload to s3://redwood-partner-ingest/nimbus/<version>/attest.tar.gz. We provide presigned URLs for parts (default TTL 24h). After upload, partner posts manifest hash + ETag for verification. Security will then verify redaction and sign off. Target turnaround: 7 business days.

mira-security: Redaction rules: redact customer names, internal IPs, hostnames; keep CVEs, CVSS, and remediation statuses. A designated redaction approver must ack before upload.

ops-bot: Policy: partner-ingest bucket presign max TTL = 86400s. Multipart presign supported. For >86400s or >10GB uploads, tag request with "presign-extend" and request ops approval. Audit logs enabled.

oliver-hw: 24h fine. We'll request multipart presigns when ready. Can you share manifest template?

sara-ps: Uploaded template: https://drive.redwood/nimbus-manifest-template.json  fields: vendor, version, release_timestamp, sha256_map (file->sha256), signer_cert_pem, signature_files, sbom_filename, soc2_summary_url, pentest_redacted_filename, chain_of_custody_filename, hsm_attestation_ref, contact_email, redaction_approver.

leo-eng: Ops note: if partner asks for IP-restricted presigns, we can add allowed-source range in approval.

mira-security: I'll reserve 30 mins on Friday for the redaction review. Tag me when the bundle is uploaded.

kai-partners: Action items captured: - Oliver/Nimbus: assemble attest.tar.gz + manifest (owner: oliver-hw) - Leo: confirm presign/multipart instructions (owner: leo-eng) - Mira: redaction checklist + review slot (owner: mira-security) - Sara: publish manifest template + S3 prefix (owner: sara-ps)

oliver-hw: Starting on this today. ETA upload request by 1718716000.

sara-ps: ingest prefix: s3://redwood-partner-ingest/nimbus/  presign-policy: max 86400s  audit: enabled.

kai-partners: Thanks all. I'll coordinate marketplace listing once artifacts are approved. :thumbsup:
